meta.description: Gentle, guilt-free nutrition tracking for the whole family.

zone.loss: Today you are in the weight-loss zone.
zone.maintenance: Today you are in the maintenance zone.
zone.gain: Today you are in the weight-gain zone.

home.streak: {days, plural, =0 {No streak yet: logging a meal today starts one.} one {# day in a row} other {# days in a row}}
home.streakFrozen: A rest day was covered this week, your streak goes on.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: No connection right now. Pages you already opened are still available; try again once you are back online.

disclaimer: {appName} is not medical advice. For any health question, talk to a professional.

login.title: Sign in
login.noAccount: No account yet? Ask the household admin for an invitation link.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Enter the code shown in your authenticator app.

setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: Create the household and your admin account. This page only works once.
setup.tokenHint: The value of the SETUP_TOKEN variable configured on the host.

invite.title: Join the {household} household
invite.intro: You've been invited. Create your account to get started.
invite.invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask the household admin for a new one.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Done! You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask the household admin for a new one.

sex.title: Your sex
sex.hint: It is only used to estimate your energy needs (Mifflin-St Jeor equation).

goal.title: What's your goal?
goal.minorHint: Under 18, we focus on balance and maintenance: your body is still growing.

targetWeight.title: Your target weight
targetWeight.label: Target weight in kg
targetWeight.hint: Optional. You can change it at any time.

1.label: Mostly calm
1.hint: Desk job, little walking, no sport.

2.label: Lightly active
2.hint: Daily walks or light exercise once or twice a week.

3.label: Active
3.hint: On your feet much of the day or exercise 3 to 4 times a week.

4.label: Very active
4.hint: Physical job or intense exercise 5 to 6 times a week.

5.label: Extremely active
5.hint: Very physical job and daily training.

diet.title: Your eating habits
diet.avoidHint: Optional. By taste or habit, for example: coriander, mushrooms.

meals.title: Your usual meal times
meals.hint: They will be used later for gentle reminders.

disclaimer.title: Before we start
disclaimer.body: {appName} helps you track what you eat, but it does not replace medical advice. For any health question, special diet, pregnancy or treatment, talk to a health professional.

summary.title: Your starting plan
summary.bmr: At rest, your body burns about {bmr} kcal a day (Mifflin-St Jeor equation, based on your age, height, weight and sex).
summary.tdee: With your activity level, your total daily expenditure is about {tdee} kcal.
summary.lose: To lose about {kg} kg a week, your goal sits a little below that: {kcal} kcal.
summary.gain: To support muscle gain, we add a small surplus: {kcal} kcal.
summary.maintain: Your goal matches your expenditure: {kcal} kcal.
summary.eta: At this pace, you would reach your target weight around {date}.
summary.adaptive: This is a starting point: the goal will fine-tune itself after two weeks of tracking.
summary.floor: To keep you well, your goal never goes below {floor} kcal a day, even if that slows things down a little.
summary.capped: To keep it sustainable and safe, weight loss is limited to about 1% of your weight per week.

budget.title: How would you like to manage your calories?

daily.label: Daily budget
daily.hint: The same goal every day. Simple and steady.

weekly.label: Weekly budget
weekly.hint: One total for the week: each day adjusts to the previous ones, and you can plan bigger days.

coach.title: Which coach suits you?
coach.hint: You can change it at any time.

profile.title: Profile
profile.twoFactorOff: Add a second layer of protection: a code from your authenticator app at each sign-in.
profile.scanQr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
profile.backupCodesHint: Keep them somewhere safe: each one lets you sign in if you lose your phone.
profile.deleteHint: All your data will be permanently erased. Enter your password to confirm.
profile.disclaimer: {appName} does not replace medical advice. For any health question, talk to a professional.
profile.aiEntryHint: Your containers and expressions help the AI understand your meals better.

admin.title: Admin
admin.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the household and erase their data?
admin.inviteLabel: Who is it for? (e.g. Mum, Leo)
admin.linkReady: Link to share (valid for {days} days, single use):
admin.resetReady: Link to share (valid for {hours} h, single use):
admin.floorsHint: The daily goal never goes below these values.
admin.aiHint: Provider, monthly spending cap and costs per member.

errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
errors.already_installed: The household is already set up. Please sign in.

errors.last_admin: The household's last admin cannot be deleted.
errors.height_range: Enter a height between 120 and 230 cm.
errors.weight_range: Enter a weight between 30 and 300 kg.
errors.wrong_direction: The target weight should match the direction of your goal.
errors.below_healthy_bmi: We'd rather not aim below {min} kg for your height: that's the threshold of a healthy weight.
errors.disclaimer_required: Please confirm you have read this message.
errors.future_date: You can't log for a day that hasn't happened yet.
errors.unit_not_available: This unit isn't available for this food.
errors.food_in_recipe: This food is used in a recipe: remove it from the recipe first.
errors.off_unavailable: Open Food Facts isn't responding right now. Try again later.
errors.off_incomplete: This product doesn't have complete nutrition values.
errors.invalid_barcode: This barcode isn't valid. Check the digits.
errors.barcode_not_found: This product isn't in Open Food Facts yet.
errors.ai_not_configured: AI is not configured. You can log your meal manually.
errors.ai_disabled: AI is paused. You can log your meal manually.
errors.ai_budget_reached: AI has reached its monthly cap. You can log your meal manually.
errors.ai_provider_error: The AI could not answer. Try again in a moment, or log your meal manually.

errors.photo_unreadable: This photo couldn't be prepared. Try another one.

errors.speech_denied: Microphone access is blocked. You can type your meal instead.
errors.speech_failed: Dictation didn't work. Try again, or type your meal.

errors.family_recipe_personal_ingredient: A household recipe can't contain your personal foods: other members can't see them.
errors.dish_weight_required: Enter the weight of the whole dish.
errors.dish_not_shared: This recipe is personal: make it a household recipe to share it.
errors.share_nobody: Choose at least one person, or enter your own portion.
errors.larger_day_range: You can mark today or a day within the next 8 weeks.

journal.title: Diary
journal.copied: {count, plural, one {# food copied} other {# foods copied}}

add.title: Add a food
add.searchHint: For example: apple, cooked rice, plain yoghurt.
add.noResults: No food found in the database.
add.emptyRecent: Foods you add will show up here.
add.emptyFavorites: Tap a food's star to find it here.
add.emptyMine: You haven't created any food or recipe yet.
add.offNoResults: No product found in Open Food Facts.
add.offAttribution: Data from Open Food Facts, under the ODbL licence; photos under CC BY-SA.
add.ciqualAttribution: Nutrition values: Anses Ciqual table, open licence.
add.shareWithFamily: Share a dish with the family

foods.title: My foods and recipes
foods.name: Name
foods.kcalHint: Leave empty to compute it from the macros.
foods.cookedHint: Optional: otherwise the ingredients are added up.
foods.familyRecipeHint: Visible to and editable by every household member.
foods.photoNotFound: Not found in the database, add them yourself: {names}.

water.title: Water
water.goalLabel: Water goal (250 ml glasses per day)

weight.title: My weight
weight.trendHint: The trend smooths out day-to-day swings (water, meals): it's what matters.
weight.weekly: {value, number, ::sign-always .00} kg per week on average
weight.notEnough: A few more weigh-ins over a week will show your pace.
weight.projection: At this pace, {target, number} kg goal around {date}.
weight.noProjection: The trend isn't heading towards your {target, number} kg goal yet, which is normal at the start.

scan.title: Scan a barcode
scan.hint: Hold the barcode inside the frame, flat and well lit.
scan.denied: The camera isn't available. Allow it in your browser settings, or type the code below.
scan.unsupported: This browser can't scan. Type the code below.
scan.manualHint: The digits under the bars, usually 8 or 13.
scan.notFoundHelp: You can create it yourself from the label, or search for it by name.

aiAdmin.title: Artificial intelligence

states.disabled: AI turned off by the admin: manual entry is still available.
states.budgetReached: Monthly cap reached: AI resumes next month, manual entry is still available.

aiAdmin.configureHint: Set LLM_API_KEY, LLM_MODEL_VISION and LLM_MODEL_TEXT in the host's environment variables (see .env.example), then redeploy.
aiAdmin.pricesMissing: Prices not set (LLM_PRICE_*): costs show as 0 and the cap cannot do its job.
aiAdmin.budgetHint: Leave empty for the default ({amount} $). Beyond it, AI pauses until next month.
aiAdmin.estimateNote: Costs estimated from the configured prices; the provider's invoice is authoritative.
aiAdmin.photosHint: Photos are kept in private storage, then deleted automatically every night after this period. A photo never added to the journal is deleted the next day.

aiEntry.title: Photo, voice or text
aiEntry.hint: Snap your plate or describe your meal: you check everything before it's added.
aiEntry.noteHint: For example: sauce on the side, half portion.
aiEntry.describeHint: For example: 2 scrambled eggs and a slice of buttered toast.

aiConfirm.title: Shall we check together?
aiConfirm.hint: Here is what the AI recognised. Adjust foods and quantities if needed: your corrections will help it next time.
aiConfirm.hintLocal: Recognised from your dictionary and habits, without calling the AI.
aiConfirm.nothingFound: No food recognised. Add them yourself, or try again with another photo.
aiConfirm.estimated: Estimated values: this food isn't in the database.
aiConfirm.values: {kcal, number} kcal · P {protein, number} g · C {carbs, number} g · F {fat, number} g
aiConfirm.incomplete: Choose a food and a quantity.

personal.containersIntro: Save your bowls, plates, glasses and mugs: pick one when you take a photo, or mention it when you describe your meal (“my big soup bowl”), for more accurate quantities.
personal.sizeHint: Enter at least the volume or the diameter.
personal.dictionaryIntro: Your own expressions (“my toast”, “my morning coffee”) linked to a specific food. In text or voice entry they are recognised right away, without calling the AI.

family.title: Family space
family.intro: Recipes and shared meals are common to the household. Your weight, goals and journal stay private.
family.partInfo: {parts, number} servings · 1 serving ≈ {grams, number} g, {kcal, number} kcal
family.noRecipes: No shared recipes yet. Create one, or make one of your recipes shared from its page.
family.shareIntro: Cooked for several people? Enter the dish once: everyone picks their portion and confirms before it's added to their journal.
family.weightHint: Enter the number of servings and the weight of the whole dish.
family.whoHint: Each person gets the dish to confirm: nothing is added to their journal without their approval.

week.title: My week
week.overspent: This week is already well filled: the remaining days keep a comfortable goal, and everything starts fresh on Monday.
week.largerHint: A family meal or a night out coming up? Tick the day: it gets a bit more, the others a bit less.
week.dailyHint: With a weekly budget you have a total for the week: what you didn't eat one day carries over to the following days, within sensible limits.
week.notLogged: Nothing logged: counted as a day on target

metabolism.title: My metabolism
metabolism.intro: Your starting expenditure is an estimate. From your meals and weigh-ins, the app measures your real expenditure and adjusts your goal every week.
metabolism.measuredDetail: Over the last {days} days, you ate {intake, number} kcal on average and your weight trend changed by {change, number, ::sign-always .00} kg per week.
metabolism.insufficient: Measuring your expenditure takes at least {days} days of tracking. Still missing:
metabolism.missingDays: {count, plural, one {# day of tracking} other {# days of tracking}}
metabolism.missingWeighIns: {count, plural, one {# weigh-in} other {# weigh-ins}} in the period
metabolism.missingLogged: {count, plural, one {# day with logged meals} other {# days with logged meals}}
metabolism.inconsistent: The last few weeks look incomplete (some meals not logged, perhaps): we keep your current goal, and that's perfectly fine.
metabolism.currentEstimate: With your current weight, the formula estimates your expenditure at {value, number} kcal per day.
metabolism.lockedHint: Your goal is locked: the weekly check no longer changes it.
metabolism.unlockedHint: Each week, the goal can move by 150 kcal at most, never below the floor.
metabolism.chart: Estimated expenditure (dashed) and measured expenditure (solid), week by week

status.adjusted: Measured expenditure {measured, number} kcal: goal adjusted from {before, number} to {after, number} kcal.
status.unchanged: Measured expenditure {measured, number} kcal: your goal of {after, number} kcal still fits.
status.locked: Measured expenditure {measured, number} kcal: goal locked at {after, number} kcal.
status.insufficient: Not enough data yet: goal unchanged.

metabolism.how1: Over the last {days} days, we compare what you ate with how your weight trend moved (the smoothed curve, not daily weigh-ins).
metabolism.how2: If your weight goes down more slowly than expected, you spend a little less than the estimate; faster, a little more. Your goal then gently moves towards what works for you.
metabolism.how3: It takes at least 14 days of tracking, 3 weigh-ins and meals logged 8 days out of 10. Adjustments are limited to 150 kcal per week and never go below the calorie floor.
metabolism.disclaimer: {appName} is not medical advice. For any health question, talk to a professional.

quality.title: Quality check
quality.indicative: Indicative markers: 30 g of fibre and 5 portions of fruit and veg (80 g) per day.
quality.empty: Nothing logged in the last 7 days: the check will appear with your first meals.

suggestions.fruitVeg: Add a piece of fruit as a snack or a handful of raw veg at lunch: every portion counts.
suggestions.fiber: A bit more fibre? Think lentils, chickpeas, wholemeal bread or oats.
suggestions.homemade: One more homemade recipe this week, even a simple one, easily replaces a ready meal.
suggestions.salt: Herbs, spices, lemon and garlic add flavour: other ways to season than salt.
suggestions.keepGoing: Great week! Keep it up, and add colour to your plate.

quality.averagesTitle: Daily averages ({days, plural, one {# day logged} other {# days logged}})
quality.averagesHint: Calculated from foods whose values are known.
quality.ultraProcessed: of calories come from ultra-processed foods (NOVA 4), among the {coverage}% whose NOVA group is known.
quality.novaUnknown: The NOVA group is only known for store-bought products scanned or found on Open Food Facts.
quality.sources: Sources: Ciqual (Anses) and Open Food Facts. ANSES, PNNS and WHO markers, for guidance only.

checkin.title: How are you feeling?
checkin.hint: Optional and only visible to you.

habitual.title: {slot, select, breakfast {Your usual breakfast?} lunch {Your usual lunch?} dinner {Your usual dinner?} other {Your usual snack?}}

coach.title: Coach
coach.intro: Ask about your meals, your goal or your habits. The coach knows your current day, nothing more.
coach.reviewLoading: The coach is preparing your weekly review…
coach.reviewEmpty: No review yet: it needs at least 3 logged days last week. It will be ready next Monday if you keep going.
coach.empty: No messages yet. For example: “What can I eat tonight with what I have left?”
coach.askHint: A question about dinner, a craving, a doubt…

teacher.label: Teacher
teacher.hint: Explains the why, with simple guidelines.

cheerleader.label: Cheerleader
cheerleader.hint: Celebrates every bit of progress and keeps you going.

chef.label: Foodie
chef.hint: Talks cooking and gives you dish ideas.

notices.floor: I'd rather not help you go below your daily minimum: it would be too little for your body. We can look together at making your meals more filling for the same calories.
notices.medical: Questions about doses or medication are for your doctor or pharmacist. I can help with your meals and habits.

coach.suggestionTitle: {slot, select, breakfast {An idea for breakfast} lunch {An idea for lunch} snack {An idea for your snack} other {An idea for dinner}}
coach.suggestionHint: A serving of {name} ({kcal} kcal) fits in what you have left today.
coach.disclaimer: The {appName} coach is not medical advice. It can make mistakes: for any health question, talk to a professional.
